title: Ironhollow Rising
author: Cyrus Ravensworth
blurb: Tamsin Fairweather, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
